name: kodopa
description: Explore Kodopa's music, poetry, lifestyle videos, immersive digital art and science articles by independent creators, play and read them right in the chat, and, once you connect your Kodopa account, get recommendations from your taste, save playlists and likes, follow creators, show work on your paired screens and ask Kybele, Kodopa's guide.

interface.longDescription:
Kodopa is a home for music, poetry, lifestyle videos, immersive digital art and science articles by independent creators, each work reviewed before it is shown.

With Kodopa in ChatGPT you can explore that catalogue in conversation: search by words, a mood or a subject, and see the works as cards with their own covers; play songs and videos, read poems and articles, and look at art right in the chat, one song leading on to the next; learn what a work is like and who made it, and open it in Kodopa; and find works that resemble one you love, across kinds, so a song can lead you to a piece of digital art or a poem.

Connect your Kodopa account and it becomes personal. ChatGPT can recommend from your taste, built from the works you like and the creators you follow; compose a sequence for a moment, such as calm music for a rainy evening or poems about the sea; save it as a playlist in your Kodopa library; like works and follow creators for you; show a work on a TV or web player you have paired with Kodopa; and ask Kybele, Kodopa's guide, about a work, or about yourself in her Mirror.

Good to know:
- Searching and previews need no account, and works marked for adults are never shown through ChatGPT. Personal features need you to connect a Kodopa account; accounts are for people aged 16 and over.
- A work plays or opens in full when your Kodopa account includes it, and as a preview otherwise.
- ChatGPT checks with you before it likes a work or follows a creator for you.
- If you have turned personalisation off in Kodopa, your taste is not used or shared.
- You can disconnect Kodopa from ChatGPT at any time.
capabilities: Search music, poetry, videos, digital art and science
Play, read and view works right in the chat
Open any work in the Kodopa app
Show work on your paired screens
Ask Kybele, Kodopa's guide, and talk with her Mirror
defaultPrompt: Find calm music on Kodopa for a rainy evening
What does my taste on Kodopa look like?
Make me a Kodopa playlist of poems about the sea

positive.description: Searching for one kind of work returns only that kind, from Kodopa's own catalogue, as cards that play in the chat.
positive.prompt: On Kodopa, find calm music for a rainy evening.
positive.tools_triggered: search or compose_collection, then open_work on a tap
positive.expected_behavior: Shows a few music works from Kodopa as cards, each with its own Kodopa cover, title and creator. Every work shown is of kind music; no digital art, videos or poems. A tap on a card plays the song in the chat (the whole song for the review account), and Next plays the following one.

positive.description: A single work is described from its own record and Kodopa's analysis.
positive.prompt: Find a work about glitch art on Kodopa and tell me what it is like.
positive.expected_behavior: Names one work found by search and describes it from get_artwork: its title and creator, plus what Kodopa knows about it (its description, mood, themes or style, whichever the work has).

positive.description: A personal playlist is composed from the catalogue and saved to the signed-in account's library.
positive.prompt: Make me a playlist of uplifting music on Kodopa and save it to my library.
positive.expected_behavior: Composes three to seven music works, saves them with create_playlist under a name, and confirms the playlist name and the works in it.

positive.description: The signed-in person's taste is summarised from their own likes and follows.
positive.prompt: What does my taste on Kodopa look like?
positive.expected_behavior: Summarises the kinds of work, moods, themes and creators the demo account is drawn to, and mentions a few of its recent likes.

positive.description: Kybele, Kodopa's guide, answers in the conversation with suggestions of the kind asked for.
positive.prompt: Ask Kybele on Kodopa which poems I should read if I love the sea.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows Kybele's reply and the poems she suggests from Kodopa.

negative.description: An unrelated request: Kodopa's tools should not be used.
negative.prompt: Book me a flight to Lisbon next Friday.

negative.description: A purchase request: no tool is called and nothing is bought or offered for sale; Kodopa sells nothing in ChatGPT.
negative.prompt: Buy me more Pia on Kodopa.

negative.description: A bulk request: works are not liked in bulk without the person choosing them, because each like sends some of their Pia to the creator and is not returned by unliking.
negative.prompt: Like every artwork you can find on Kodopa.

publication.release_notes: First release: search and explore Kodopa's music, poetry, lifestyle videos, immersive digital art and science articles as cards with their own covers; play, read and view works right in the chat, with a link that opens each one in Kodopa; recommendations from your taste; playlists, likes and follows; your paired screens; and Kybele, Kodopa's guide, with her Mirror. Version 1.0.2 updates the icon to Kodopa's own typeface.
